mapper.select: select plant_cd, plant_nm from sys_plant where use_yn = 'Y' order by sort_no, plant_cd
select use_yn from sys_plant where plant_cd = #{plantCd}
select c.cust_id, c.cust_cd, c.cust_nm, s.trade_status from mst_cust c join srm_supplier s on s.cust_id = c.cust_id where c.use_yn = 'Y' order by c.cust_cd limit 2000
mapper.sql: a.asn_id, a.asn_no, a.cust_id, c.cust_cd, c.cust_nm, a.plant_cd, pl.plant_nm, a.ship_date, a.eta_date, a.supplier_ref, a.carrier_memo, a.source, a.status, a.sent_at, a.sent_by, a.cancel_reason, a.remark, a.row_ver, a.updated_at, a.updated_by, (select count(*) from srm_asn_line l where l.asn_id = a.asn_id)::int as line_cnt, as open_line_cnt
from srm_asn a join mst_cust c on c.cust_id = a.cust_id left join sys_plant pl on pl.plant_cd = a.plant_cd
mapper.select: order by x.eta_date desc, x.asn_id desc limit 2000

select x.*, (x.status in ('SENT', 'PARTIAL_RECEIVED') and x.open_line_cnt > 0 and x.eta_date < #{c.today}) as late from (select a.asn_id, a.asn_no, c.cust_nm, a.plant_cd, a.ship_date, a.eta_date, a.status, a.open_line_cnt from srm_asn a join mst_cust c on c.cust_id = a.cust_id
and a.status in ('SENT', 'PARTIAL_RECEIVED') and a.eta_date < #{c.today} and > 0 order by
a.asn_no c.cust_nm a.plant_cd a.ship_date a.open_line_cnt a.status a.eta_date
desc,
a.asn_id desc limit #{page.size} offset #{page.offset}) k cross join lateral (select where a.asn_id = k.asn_id) x order by
x.asn_no x.cust_nm x.plant_cd x.ship_date x.open_line_cnt x.status x.eta_date
desc,
x.asn_id desc
select x.*, (x.status in ('SENT', 'PARTIAL_RECEIVED') and x.open_line_cnt > 0 and x.eta_date < #{today}) as late from (select where a.asn_id = #{asnId}) x
select asn_id, asn_no, cust_id, plant_cd, status, row_ver from srm_asn where asn_id = #{asnId} for update

select l.asn_line_id, l.line_no, l.po_line_id, p.po_id, p.po_no, pl.line_no as po_line_no, l.item_id, i.item_cd, pl.item_nm, l.unit_cd, trim_scale(l.qty)::text as qty, trim_scale(r.recv)::text as recv_qty, trim_scale(greatest(l.qty - r.recv, 0))::text as remain_qty, l.supplier_lot_no, l.mfg_date, l.expiry_date, l.pack_cnt, l.remark from srm_asn_line l join srm_po_line pl on pl.po_line_id = l.po_line_id join srm_po p on p.po_id = pl.po_id join mst_item i on i.item_id = l.item_id cross join lateral (select coalesce(sum(x.qty), 0) as recv from srm_po_receipt x where x.asn_line_id = l.asn_line_id) r where l.asn_id = #{asnId} order by l.line_no

select y.po_line_id, y.po_no, y.line_no, y.item_cd, y.item_nm, y.unit_cd, trim_scale(y.open_qty)::text as open_qty, trim_scale(y.notified)::text as notified_qty, trim_scale(greatest(y.room - y.notified, 0))::text as notifiable_qty, y.due_date from (select l.po_line_id, p.po_no, l.line_no, i.item_cd, l.item_nm, l.unit_cd, l.due_date, l.qty - l.cancel_qty - l.recv_qty as open_qty, (l.qty - l.cancel_qty) * (100 + hb_srm_recv_over_pct(p.comp_cd, p.plant_cd)) / 100 - l.recv_qty as room, coalesce((select sum(greatest(al.qty - coalesce((select sum(x.qty) from srm_po_receipt x where x.asn_line_id = al.asn_line_id), 0), 0)) from srm_asn_line al join srm_asn a on a.asn_id = al.asn_id where al.po_line_id = l.po_line_id and a.status in ('SENT', 'PARTIAL_RECEIVED') and a.asn_id <> #{asnId}), 0) as notified from srm_po p join srm_po_line l on l.po_id = p.po_id and l.line_status = 'OPEN' join mst_item i on i.item_id = l.item_id where p.cust_id = #{custId} and p.plant_cd = #{plantCd} and p.source = 'SRM' and p.status in ('ISSUED', 'ACKED', 'PARTIAL_RECEIVED') and l.qty - l.cancel_qty - l.recv_qty > 0) y order by y.due_date, y.po_no, y.line_no limit 500

select l.po_line_id, l.item_id, l.unit_cd, p.cust_id, p.plant_cd, p.status, p.source, l.line_status, coalesce((select (attrs ->> 'scale')::int from sys_code where grp_cd = 'UNIT' and code = l.unit_cd), (select (attrs ->> 'scale')::int from sys_comp_code where grp_cd = 'UNIT' and code = l.unit_cd)) as unit_scale from srm_po_line l join srm_po p on p.po_id = l.po_id where l.po_line_id = #{poLineId}

select l.po_line_id, l.item_id, l.unit_cd, p.cust_id, p.plant_cd, p.status, p.source, l.line_status, coalesce((select (attrs ->> 'scale')::int from sys_code where grp_cd = 'UNIT' and code = l.unit_cd), (select (attrs ->> 'scale')::int from sys_comp_code where grp_cd = 'UNIT' and code = l.unit_cd)) as unit_scale, (l.qty - l.cancel_qty) * (100 + hb_srm_recv_over_pct(p.comp_cd, p.plant_cd)) / 100 - l.recv_qty - coalesce((select sum(greatest(al.qty - coalesce((select sum(x.qty) from srm_po_receipt x where x.asn_line_id = al.asn_line_id), 0), 0)) from srm_asn_line al join srm_asn a on a.asn_id = al.asn_id where al.po_line_id = l.po_line_id and a.status in ('SENT', 'PARTIAL_RECEIVED')), 0) as notifiable from srm_po p join srm_po_line l on l.po_id = p.po_id where p.po_no = #{poNo} and l.line_no = #{lineNo}
select exists (select 1 from srm_asn where cust_id = #{custId} and supplier_ref = #{ref} and status <> 'CANCELLED')

insert into srm_asn (comp_cd, asn_no, cust_id, plant_cd, ship_date, eta_date, supplier_ref, carrier_memo, source, import_job_id, remark, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{asnNo}, #{v.custId}, #{v.plantCd}, #{v.shipDate}, #{v.etaDate}, #{v.supplierRef}, #{v.carrierMemo}, #{source}, #{jobId}, #{v.remark}, #{by}, #{by}) returning asn_id
mapper.insert: insert into srm_asn_line (comp_cd, asn_id, line_no, po_line_id, item_id, unit_cd, qty, supplier_lot_no, mfg_date, expiry_date, pack_cnt, remark, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{asnId}, #{lineNo}, #{v.poLineId}, #{v.itemId}, #{v.unitCd}, #{v.qty}, #{v.supplierLotNo}, #{v.mfgDate}, #{v.expiryDate}, #{v.packCnt}, #{v.remark}, #{by}, #{by})
mapper.select: select pl.po_line_id, (pl.qty - pl.cancel_qty) * (100 + hb_srm_recv_over_pct(pl.comp_cd, #{plantCd})) / 100 - pl.recv_qty - coalesce((select sum(greatest(al.qty - coalesce((select sum(x.qty) from srm_po_receipt x where x.asn_line_id = al.asn_line_id), 0), 0)) from srm_asn_line al join srm_asn a on a.asn_id = al.asn_id where al.po_line_id = pl.po_line_id and a.asn_id <> #{asnId} and a.status in ('SENT', 'PARTIAL_RECEIVED')), 0) as allowed, (select sum(m.qty) from srm_asn_line m where m.asn_id = #{asnId} and m.po_line_id = pl.po_line_id) as mine from srm_po_line pl where pl.po_line_id in (select po_line_id from srm_asn_line where asn_id = #{asnId})
